description: This Dart source file defines a class MockNewsData that provides mock news articles for offline and fallback scenarios in a Flutter news app. It includes methods to generate category-specific mock articles and references an external model NewsArticle.

classes.name: MockNewsData
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate mock news articles for different categories, mainly used for offline/preview scenarios.

methods.name: forCategory
methods.description: Returns a list of mock NewsArticle instances tailored to a specific category, combining general mock articles with category-specific entries.
